question: Which of the following enzymes related to the lipogenic pathway is activated by citrate (allosteric activator) ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Citrate -> activates Acetyl-coenzyme A carboxylase -> 80% CHAIN: Citrate -> promotes lipogenesis -> activates Fatty acid synthase -> 75% CHAIN: Citrate -> enhances malonyl-CoA production -> activates Fatty acid synthase -> 70% CHAIN: Citrate -> stimulates lipogenesis -> activates Fatty acid synthase -> 80%
analysis: Citrate is known to activate Acetyl-coenzyme A carboxylase in the lipogenic pathway.
